about_short_description.short_description: Apero Health is a tech-focused medical billing company that gives greater control to practices and patients about their medical payments.

product.name: Apero Medical Practice Management Software
product.description: An integrated software suite for managing scheduling, clinical notes, prescriptions, billing, and financial reporting in medical practices.

identifier.value: Insurance Billing and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)

product.name: Insurance Billing and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
product.description: A complete end-to-end insurance billing system supporting claim submission, payer enrollment, and automated claim status updates.

product.name: Patient Billing and Payment Management
product.description: A patient billing system that supports custom branding and automates patient collections.

product.name: Scheduling and Clinical Documentation
product.description: Tools for patient scheduling, clinical note-taking, and video visit support within medical practices.

product.name: E-Prescriptions and Medication Management
product.description: A system for prescribing medications, including controlled substances, with access to patient medication history and cost estimation.

product.name: Advanced Reporting and Analytics
product.description: Custom and pre-built reporting tools covering scheduling, billing, and financial operations for medical practices.
